Mat: He is still linked to the Horn, so when does he get it and when does he use it?

Nicola's Prophecy: The lion sword, the dedicated spear, she who sees beyond. Three on the boat, and he who is dead yet lives. The great battle done, but the world not done with battle. The land divided by the return, and the guardians balance the servants. The future teeters on the edge of a blade. Book 6, Nicola foretelling.
